title: Accessibility
definition: The implementation and design of enviornments, products, services, and technology that allows for easy use and operation by all individuals.

title: Disability
definition: A physical, mental, cognitive, or developmental impairment that interferes with or limits an individuals daily activities and interactions.

title: Wheelchair user
definition:
An individual who relies on a wheelchair for daily mobility.
![](https://www.stronggo.com/sites/default/files/2023-01/shutterstock_716571097.jpg)

title: Able-bodied
definition: A person who is non-disabled and has the physical and mental capacities to complete daily activites and operate independently.

title: KCSB
definition:
Local radio station headquartered at UC Santa Barbara that broadcasts to the greater Central Coast of California.
![](https://www.kcsb.org/wp-content/themes/kcsb2019/images/KCSB--logo.png)

title: Tactile Paving
definition:
Textured ground indicators installed on sidewalks, stairs, and transit platforms. Serves as detectable warning surfaces for individuals with visual impairments as they navigate public spaces.
![](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0045/4072/7407/files/person_with_cane_and_sneakers_tapping_yellow_domes_480x480.jpg?v=1613513484)

title: Braille
definition:
A tactile writing system used by individuals who have visual impairments, allowing them to read and write through touch.
![](https://afb.org/serve/media/8042)

title: Unconscious Bias
definition:
The automatic, unintentional stereotypes or prejudices projected onto groups of people.
![](https://diverseek.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/unconsious-bias.jpg)

title: Polio (Poliomyelitis)
definition:
A highly contagious and life-threatening viral-disease that targets the body's central nervous system, leaving many survivors paralyzed. Largely eliminated in the second-half of the 20th century with the development of vaccines and immunizations that stopped the spread of the disease.
![](https://www.christopherreeve.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/postpolio.jpg)

title: Infrastructure
definition: The foundational systems, structures, and facilities of an environment that allows it to function effectively.

title: Spina bifida
definition:
A birth defect in the central nervous system where a baby's spine and spinal cord do not develop properly. Effects vary depending on the severity of cases, ranging from little to no mobility issues or severe physical limitations.
![](https://www.christopherreeve.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/shutterstock_1589691085-Spina-Bifida-scaled.jpg)
